LIST.summary: Lists the immediate child namespaces of a namespace, or the root namespaces when no path is given.
LIST.complexity: O(N) where N is the number of immediate child namespaces.

reply_schema.description: The names of the child namespaces. Empty when there are none.

arguments.name: namespace
arguments.summary: Dot-separated hierarchical path of the namespace to list the child namespaces of, for example staging.orders. When omitted, the root namespaces are listed.
